title: Words that become operating systems
summary: Edit durable instructions and handoff artifacts so they preserve decisions instead of conversation residue.
whyItExists: This family reflects recurring writing work where future agents needed compact, stateful, reusable guidance.

provenance.rationale: Fictional instruction and brief excerpts preserve the work shape without real agent files.

setup.context: All excerpts are fictional. Preserve the requested meaning and constraints; do not treat the text as a real policy.

dishes.title: Tighten a tuned instruction set
dishes.summary: Propose a surgical edit that removes drift without erasing a useful voice.
dishes.whyItExists: An ordinary representative encounter for respecting already tuned durable text.

turns.label: Make a minimal edit
turns.prompt: A fictional agent instruction says: “You are a calm front desk with deep work behind you. We always use every available provider because redundancy is wisdom. The assistant should tell the user that they need to wait while the workers think. Keep the next action visible.” The team wants to preserve the helpful image and the visibility rule, remove provider debate, and fix the mixed perspective. How would you revise it and explain the scope of change?

observationLenses: Whether it preserves stated intent rather than rewriting from scratch.
Whether it separates durable rules from temporary rationale.
Whether voice and grammatical perspective remain coherent.
dishes.repeatVariationGuidance: Vary the residue or perspective leak while retaining a small core worth preserving.

externalCorrectnessChecks.title: Diff and consistency scan
externalCorrectnessChecks.method: Compare the revision with the requested retained rules and scan for mixed actor perspective or unsupported platform claims.

dishes.title: A durable policy without meeting minutes
dishes.summary: Compress exploratory discussion into a decision-ready policy.
dishes.whyItExists: Tests whether models can retain decisions without memorializing the entire route to them.

turns.label: Distill the policy
turns.prompt: A fictional team policy says: “After a long debate about several vendors and a confusing incident last winter, we agreed that production changes should be reversible, reviewed, and explained to the operator. Remember when the old blue tool failed? Do not repeat that. Also, our chatbot may someday get a dashboard.” The intended durable decisions are: changes need a rollback path, a named reviewer, and a concise operator-facing reason. How would you turn this into a policy that a future worker can use?

observationLenses: Whether it removes historical residue while retaining the actual decisions.
Whether it avoids adding rules not present in the brief.
Whether the final artifact is concise and operational.
dishes.repeatVariationGuidance: Replace the discussion residue and decisions with another compact, fictional policy target.

externalCorrectnessChecks.title: Required-rule check
externalCorrectnessChecks.method: Compare the result against the explicitly intended decisions and verify that incidental lore was not retained as a requirement.

dishes.title: A goal file that can stop
dishes.summary: Write a staged handoff artifact with approval gates and a live-state re-audit.
dishes.whyItExists: Tests whether an execution brief enables later continuation without silently expanding authority.

setup.context: This is only a writing exercise; no task should be executed.

turns.label: Draft a resumable goal
turns.prompt: A fictional task has three phases: inspect a current integration state, propose a migration plan for approval, then make a reversible configuration change and verify it. The work may pause between phases, and the state can change while paused. Draft a compact goal file or handoff brief that lets a future worker resume safely and makes the stopping condition clear.

observationLenses: Whether it includes a re-audit after a pause.
Whether approval is explicit at the consequential boundary.
Whether “complete” is tied to an observable verification.
dishes.repeatVariationGuidance: Vary the phases and approval boundary, while preserving a possible pause and a mutable live state.

externalCorrectnessChecks.title: Cold-read handoff
externalCorrectnessChecks.method: Give the artifact to a reviewer who did not see the prompt and check whether they can identify state, authority, next step, and stopping condition.
